Clicking an action that was already APPROVED is idempotent success (`desfecho: ja_aprovada`), recording the pattern only if it is missing."

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}

  context={"endpoint"}
>

Besides releasing this action, it adds the corresponding pattern to the project's `allow` list — future matching actions come out `auto_approved` without asking. A pattern already in `deny` stays blocked. The approval and the pattern are recorded in the same transaction. Clicking an action that was already APPROVED is idempotent success (`desfecho: ja_aprovada`), recording the pattern only if it is missing.
